restoreConfirm.message: Your current data will be replaced by the data in the file.

undoConfirm.title: Undo the restore?
undoConfirm.message: Your data goes back to what it was before the last restore.

backup.restoredPartial: Data restored successfully. Check your reminders and Copilot.
backup.undone: Restore undone. Your previous data is back.

invalid.notBackup: This file isn't a valid backup from this app.

marketConfirm.message: This backup is from {{country}}. The currency and offer reading will follow {{country}}, and amounts come back with the same numbers, with no currency conversion.

backup.notSaved: The backup wasn't marked as done. Tap "Back up now" and save the file somewhere safe, like Google Drive.

savedQuestion.title: Did you save the file?

platforms.keepOne: Keep at least one platform active to record your earnings.

data.title: Your data
data.body: Everything stays on your phone. The app has no account, no server, and no internet permission. Project links open in your browser.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.body: Location, notifications, display over other apps, and accessibility are optional and only used by the features you turn on. If you turn on screen image reading in Copilot, the app may use it on Uber and 99 to find the offer. The image is read on your phone and discarded right away, without being saved or sent.

copilot.title: Copilot
copilot.body: Reads the fare, distance, time, and rating of offers. It stores only the numbers, the result, and whether you tapped accept or decline, without the rating, names, addresses, conversations, or images. It doesn't touch the screen. Offers are kept for up to 12 months, and earnings estimates can be turned off in Offers and earnings. The offer notification doesn't appear on the lock screen.

backup.title: Backup
backup.body: It only leaves your device when you share the file. It contains your financial data and has no password, so keep it somewhere only you can access.

estimates.title: Estimates
estimates.body: The results are estimates based on the data you enter. They aren't financial or tax advice.

about.title: What the app is
about.body: {{appName}} helps you understand costs, profit, and offers. It's free, doesn't require an account, and works offline.

estimates.title: Estimates
estimates.body: The results are estimates based on the data you enter and on what the app can read from the screen. They may contain errors, don't guarantee earnings, and aren't financial, tax, or legal advice.

decisions.title: Your decisions
decisions.body: The app only informs. It doesn't accept or decline rides, and every decision is yours.

traffic.title: On the road
traffic.body: Set up and check the app only when the car is stopped. While driving, use the voice. You're responsible for following traffic laws.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.body: {{appName}} is independent and isn't affiliated with Uber, 99, inDrive, or other platforms. Each one has its own rules about helper apps, and it's up to you to know them before using Copilot. Platforms can detect apps that use accessibility or display over other apps, and using them may have consequences for your account.

data.title: Your data
data.body: Your data stays on your phone, with no copy on our servers. If you lose the device or uninstall the app, it's lost. That's why you should make backups and keep the file somewhere only you can access.

warranty.title: No warranty
warranty.body: The app is provided as is, with no warranty of continuous operation or compatibility with the platforms. To the extent permitted by law, the project maintainers aren't liable for losses resulting from its use.

license.title: License
license.body: You may use the app in your work as a driver. Selling the app or derived versions, charging for it, or showing ads in it is prohibited. The full text is in the LICENSE file in the project repository.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: These terms may change in new versions of the app. Questions and problems can be sent through the Report a problem option, in More.

reminders.distanceHint_mi: The app adds up the miles from your shifts and alerts you on the home screen.

market.title: Country where you drive
market.hint: The currency and offer reading follow the country, because amounts come from the platforms' screens there. New countries are added when reading their platforms is ready.
market.confirmMessage: Saved amounts keep the same numbers, now in {{currency}}. The app does not convert currency.
market.learnMore: Why does the currency follow the country?

privacyChoices.intro: You decide what the app can send. Your earnings, shifts and offers stay on your phone.

usageStats.label: Help improve the app
usageStats.hint: Sends anonymous usage statistics, such as which screens are opened and whether the Copilot is on, without your name or your amounts.

crashReports.label: Send crash reports
crashReports.hint: When the app crashes, sends the error, the phone model and the Android version so the crash can be fixed.

never.title: What is never sent
never.body: The text and image read from offers, names and addresses of passengers and customers, your location and your earnings.

card.title: Your privacy choices
card.message: Decide whether the app can send anonymous usage statistics and crash reports. Everything stays off until you choose.

deleteData.title: Delete all data?
deleteData.message: Vehicles, shifts, expenses, goals, offers and settings are removed from this phone, and the app closes and starts over. This cannot be undone. If you want to keep a copy, make a backup first.
